description: CR 702.134a a creature whose power is not less is no legal target
note: Mentor's "power less than this creature's power" is strict, so a Hill Giant attacking beside the 3-power Blade Instructor is no legal target, and neither is the Instructor itself: nothing is mentored. Same declaration as the proving test; only the fellow attacker's power differs. A filter that admitted the Giant would ask for the trigger's target, which fails the run, or put a counter on it.
